{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the structure
print('Data shape:', sales.shape)
print('\nFirst few rows:\n', sales.head())
print('\nData types:\n', sales.dtypes)
print('\nUnique values in channel:\n', sales['channel'].unique())
print('\nUnique values in customer_segment:\n', sales['customer_segment'].unique())
print('\nUnique values in status:\n', sales['status'].unique())
print('\nMissing values:\n', sales.isnull().sum())

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print('\nCount of customer_age == -1:', (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print('\nFirst few revenue values:', sales['revenue'].head().tolist())
print('\nUnique revenue values (first 10):', sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])"}
